name: Enter a version
description: Recording a submission as a testing version. A submission is two hashes and two uploads -- there is no release and no repository, and `version` is a counter this statement assigns rather than a label the competitor types. Two statements, not one: db_write returns only rows_affected, so the row is read back, and both statements join live_sessions -- a revoked session must neither write nor read, and the read-back alone deciding 201 would fail open. The insert carries the open season's rules as PREDICATES, so a refusal is a row that was never written rather than a check that could be raced; zero rows then sends `why` to read the state back and `refused` answers 409 with one word. The duplicate refusal deliberately does not name the version it collided with: unique_weights excludes the caller, so the row it matched is always another competitor's, and naming or dating it would report one competitor's submission to another.

body.detail: weights_hash and manifest_hash are required, each as sha256:<64 hex>. Run `sha256sum model.onnx manifest.json` on the two files you are about to upload.

with.name: Both hashes, declared and well formed
with.description: `sha256:` and 71 characters, which is the shape and not the alphabet -- datalogic has no regex operator. The alphabet does not have to be checked here: the object key is a GENERATED column derived from the version id, so a hash is never a path.

input.query: INSERT INTO model_versions (model_id, game_id, season_id, version, weights_hash, manifest_hash) SELECT e.id, g.id, s.id, coalesce(max(v.version), 0) + 1, ($5)::text, ($6)::text FROM games g JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.submissions_open_at <= now() AND now() < s.submissions_close_at JOIN models e ON e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND e.retired_at IS NULL AND e.id = ($3)::uuid JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.sid = ($4)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid LEFT JOIN model_versions v ON v.model_id = e.id WHERE g.slug = ($2)::text AND season_admits(s, ($1)::uuid) AND season_admits_weights(s, ($1)::uuid, ($5)::text, e.id) AND season_admits_in_flight(s, ($1)::uuid) AND season_admits_version(s, ($1)::uuid, e.id) AND season_admits_cooldown(s, e.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_versions f WHERE f.model_id = e.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')) GROUP BY e.id, g.id, s.id

SELECT json_build_object( 'season', s.slug, 'state', CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN season_state(s) END, 'submissions_open_at', s.submissions_open_at, 'submissions_close_at', s.submissions_close_at, 'model', (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'retired', e.retired_at IS NOT NULL) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND e.id = ($4)::uuid), 'participant', s.id IS NULL OR season_admits(s, ($2)::uuid), 'in_flight', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('version_id', f.id, 'model_id', f.model_id, 'model', fe.name, 'version', f.version, 'phase', model_phase(f)) ORDER BY fe.name) FROM model_versions f JOIN models fe ON fe.id = f.model_id WHERE fe.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND fe.game_id = g.id AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')), '[]'::json), 'same_submission', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_versions f JOIN models fe ON fe.id = f.model_id WHERE fe.game_id = g.id AND fe.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND fe.id = ($4)::uuid AND f.status = 'testing' AND f.weights_hash = ($3)::text AND f.manifest_hash = ($5)::text), 'entry_in_flight', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_versions f JOIN models fe ON fe.id = f.model_id WHERE fe.game_id = g.id AND fe.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND fe.id = ($4)::uuid AND f.status IN ('testing', 'verified')), 'in_flight_ok', s.id IS NULL OR season_admits_in_flight(s, ($2)::uuid), 'versions_ok', s.id IS NULL OR (SELECT season_admits_version(s, ($2)::uuid, e.id) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND e.id = ($4)::uuid), 'cooldown_until', (SELECT season_cooldown_until(s, e.id) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND e.id = ($4)::uuid), 'unique_weights_scope', coalesce(s.rules -> 'unique_weights' ->> 'scope', 'game'), 'unique_weights', s.id IS NULL OR (SELECT season_admits_weights(s, ($2)::uuid, ($3)::text, e.id) FROM models e WHERE e.game_id = g.id AND e.owner_id = ($2)::uuid AND e.id = ($4)::uuid)) AS body FROM games g LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text

with.name: No such model
with.description: A submission names a model the caller does not own, or does not have: 404 and not 409, because nothing about the season refused it. Entries are created explicitly -- a repository with no entry behind it is not silently adopted, or a typo in a repo path would quietly start a second lineage with its own version numbers.

with.name: Refused by the season
with.description: `entry_in_flight` refuses only a DIFFERENT submission. Re-POSTing the SAME two hashes for the row already in flight falls through to fetch + sign and answers with fresh upload URLs, which is what the response has always promised and never did: the presigns expire in thirty minutes, and before this a competitor who lost them had a version they could not upload to and could not replace.

tasks.name: Read the row back
tasks.description: Keyed on the entry id and the declared weights hash rather than a release tag: model_versions_one_in_flight_uniq makes at most one 'testing' row per entry, so the pair is unique. It is also the read-back the 401 guard rides -- a revoked session must neither write nor read, and the read-back alone deciding 201 would fail open.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('version_id', v.id, 'model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'version', v.version, 'status', v.status, 'season', se.slug, 'weights_hash', v.weights_hash, 'manifest_hash', v.manifest_hash) AS body FROM model_versions v JOIN models e ON e.id = v.model_id JOIN games g ON g.id = e.game_id JOIN seasons se ON se.id = v.season_id AND se.closed_at IS NULL JOIN live_sessions s ON s.sid = ($4)::uuid AND s.user_id = e.owner_id WHERE e.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND g.slug = ($2)::text AND e.id = ($3)::uuid AND v.status = 'testing' AND v.weights_hash = ($5)::text

tasks.name: Sign both uploads
tasks.description: Both presigns are asked the same question -- did the INSERT create a version -- so the group carries the condition once and the two steps inside carry none. Neither writes what it reads, so one evaluation is the whole answer.

tasks.description: 201 when the insert created the row, 200 when it did not -- which is the re-mint: the same two hashes for the version already in flight answer with fresh presigned URLs and nothing was created.

if.note: PUT your two files to these URLs. They are one-shot and expire in 30 minutes; POST this submission again with the same two hashes to get fresh ones.
